about.title: About LumaPeak Services
about.intro: LumaPeak Services is a residential exterior cleaning company serving homeowners throughout the Greater Seattle area.
about.body: We specialize in professional window cleaning, roof cleaning, gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning, skylight cleaning, and holiday lighting installation. Our focus is on high-quality workmanship, excellent customer service, and reliable communication — helping homeowners improve and maintain the appearance of their properties.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your exterior cleaning.

items.a: Yes. LumaPeak Services is fully licensed and insured, so your home and our team are protected on every job.

items.q: How do I get a quote, and is it free?
items.a: Just fill out the quote form on this page or give us a call. Estimates are always free and with no obligation — we typically respond the same day.
We serve homeowners throughout the Greater Seattle area, generally within about 25 miles of Seattle. If your city isn't listed on our map, call us to verify availability.

items.q: Is your roof cleaning safe for my roof?
items.a: Absolutely. We use a gentle low-pressure soft-wash method (and zinc treatments when appropriate) that safely removes moss and algae without damaging your shingles.

items.q: Do I need to be home during the service?
items.a: Not necessarily. As long as our team has access to the areas being cleaned, you don't have to be present. We'll keep you updated throughout the job.

items.q: How do you price your services?
items.a: Pricing depends on the size of your home and the scope of the work. We'll give you a clear, upfront estimate before any work begins — no surprises.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
body: By requesting a quote, scheduling a service, or using this website, you agree to these Terms & Conditions.

sections.heading: Services
body: LumaPeak Services provides residential exterior cleaning — including window, roof, gutter, solar panel and skylight cleaning, and holiday lighting — within the Greater Seattle area. We service residential properties only.

sections.heading: Quotes & Pricing
body: All prices and "starting at" figures are estimates. Final pricing depends on property size, accessibility, roof condition and project scope, and is confirmed before work begins.

sections.heading: Scheduling & Property Access
body: You agree to provide safe, reasonable access to the property and to disclose any known hazards. We are not responsible for delays caused by inaccessible areas, pets, or unsafe conditions.

sections.heading: Payment
body: Payment is due upon completion of the service unless otherwise agreed in writing. We accept the payment methods communicated at the time of booking.

sections.heading: Cancellations & Rescheduling
body: Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Repeated last-minute cancellations may be subject to a fee.

sections.heading: Weather
body: For safety and quality, services may be rescheduled due to weather conditions such as rain, ice or high winds.

sections.heading: Satisfaction Guarantee
body: We stand behind our work. If you are not satisfied, contact us within 48 hours of service and we will make it right.

sections.heading: Liability
body: We are licensed and insured and take care to protect your property. However, we are not liable for pre-existing damage, faulty or aged materials, or conditions beyond our reasonable control. Our total liability is limited to the amount paid for the affected service.

sections.heading: Governing Law
body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Washington, USA.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the current Terms.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Questions? Contact us at lumapeakservices@gmail.com or 425-922-4918.

sections.heading: Overview
body: This Privacy Policy explains how LumaPeak Services collects, uses and protects your personal information.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
body: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, phone number, email address and property address — when you request a quote, contact us, or book a service.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
body: We use your information to respond to inquiries, prepare quotes, schedule and perform services, process payments, and communicate with you about your project.

sections.heading: Text Messaging (SMS)
body: If you contact us or opt in by text, you consent to receive SMS messages related to your inquiry and service. Message and data rates may apply. You can opt out at any time by replying STOP.

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
body: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us operate our business (such as scheduling or payment processing) and when required by law.

sections.heading: Data Retention
body: We keep your information only as long as needed to provide our services and to meet legal or accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Data Security
body: We use reasonable measures to protect your information, but no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.

sections.heading: Your Rights
body: You may request to access, correct or delete your personal information by contacting us.

sections.heading: Cookies & Website
body: Our website may use basic cookies or analytics to improve your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
body: Our services are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The latest version will always be available on this website.
